title.en: Fable 9 — The Peacock and the Crane

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.ar: טווס עמד בגן ופתח את הזנב.
sentences.en: A peacock stood in the garden and opened his tail.
His tail was full of colours.
Everyone who passed stopped and looked.
The peacock walked slowly from side to side.
A grey crane came down to the garden to eat.
The peacock looked at him and laughed.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: תראה איזה צבע יש לך.
sentences.en: He said: look what a colour you have.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אתה אפור כמו אבן.
sentences.en: He said: you are grey like a stone.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: ואני יפה כמו מלך.
sentences.en: He said: and I am beautiful like a king.

sentences.ar: העגור אמר: נכון, אתה יפה מאוד.
sentences.en: The crane said: true, you are very beautiful.
The crane opened his wings slowly.
He rose upwards, to the sky.

sentences.ar: הוא עף מעל הבתים ומעל העצים.
sentences.en: He flew above the houses and above the trees.
The peacock remained standing on the ground.
He opened his wings and tried.

sentences.ar: הוא לא עלה אפילו מטר אחד.
sentences.en: He did not rise even one metre.

sentences.ar: העגור קרא לו מלמעלה: אני הולך.
sentences.en: The crane called to him from above: I am going.

sentences.ar: מי שיפה בלי כוח לא מגיע רחוק.
sentences.en: Beauty without strength does not take one far.
